'''Juggernaut Four''' was an [[HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport]] used to move [[rhydonium]] on the [[planet]] [[Morak]]<ref name="Chapter 15" /> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> The transport was attacked and subsequently destroyed by [[Shydopp]] [[Shydopp pirates|raiders]], shortly prior to [[Juggernaut Three|another transport]] being [[Mission to Morak|attacked]] and destroyed.<ref name="Chapter 15" />
